title: Thai yellow chicken curry over jasmine rice

source.name: Evolving Table: Thai Yellow Chicken Curry

equipment: Large Dutch oven or deep pot
ingredients: 3 lb chicken breast, in 1 inch cubes
(1) 4 oz can Thai yellow curry paste (Maesri or Mae Ploy); use 3/4 of it for milder
4 medium sweet potatoes, in 3/4 inch cubes
To serve: jasmine rice, lime wedges, cilantro

steps.do: Start the rice. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook the onions 3 to 5 minutes, until starting to soften.
Add the chicken and the curry paste and stir 3 to 5 minutes, until the chicken is coated and starting to turn white.
Add the peppers, carrots, sweet potatoes, coconut milk, sugar and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 25 to 35 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Serve over rice with lime and cilantro.

changes: Store-bought Thai yellow curry paste, not curry powder.
Double batch with 3 lb chicken for 8 portions at 40g+ protein.
Sweet potatoes and frozen carrots instead of Yukon golds and fresh carrots.
Sugar cut to 1 tbsp for the double batch.
